name: screener
description: Ghost.exe presents Screener: see what you're about to tell an AI, before it does. Screens prompts, files and chat history with Deliverd Screen, and asks a person before risky content is sent.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --sourcemap --outfile=public/app.js && cp node_modules/@ui-sdk/web/browser/web.css public/web.css && node scripts/favicon.mjs
